verdict.rationale: Better Stack offers API access to manage resources (docs-15, docs-45, docs-51) and mentions a 'flexible data export' for team performance reporting (docs-56), suggesting some data portability, but there is no evidence of comprehensive export of all logs/metrics/traces/incidents in open, portable formats or documentation of an account-wide export/leave workflow. Missing for 10: dedicated bulk data export documentation covering all data types (logs, metrics, traces, monitors, incidents), explicit open-format guarantees, and any account deletion/data portability workflow.
